'''Olavey''' was a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] who served on board the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']]. Olavey was originally going to take [[TIE Reconnaissance Fighter|the Blur]] out on a test run before [[Darth Caedus]] used the Blur to escape the ''Anakin Solo''.
